notes: Evals 1-2 run on a bare create-next-app scaffold (App Router, no shadcn). Eval 3 needs a scaffold pre-seeded with components.json style 'radix-mira' (a non-standard base — the deviation under test), a components/ui/button.tsx, and a page containing a hardcoded hex color and a raw <table>. Eval 4 runs on a project already set up by this skill but with an older ugt-core version recorded in docs/DESIGN.md. Evals 6-7 are DIFFERENT IN KIND from 1-5: 1-5 grade the install moment, 6-7 grade what the agreement is actually for — that the SECOND feature built weeks later still matches the first. They run on a project already set up by this skill with one finished list page, and the agent is given a normal feature request with no design instructions at all. Machine-checkable assertions use scripts/verify.mjs and scripts/check-contrast.mjs as graders. Prompts stay in Thai: they simulate real user input.
